initialisation.flow: four identity affine couplings; odd layers conjugated by two-level Haar; no net initial rotation
initialisation.means: K linspace(...).long indices on all nonoverlap four-point FIT blocks; no SELECT/CAL/QUERY
initialisation.noise: FIT coordinate standard deviation, sigma=.05+9.95sigmoid(raw), inverse-logit probability clamp1e-6
initialisation.dynamic_factors: seed2025 U=N(0,.02), V=N(0,.002), rank min(8,4C); no zero cross gradient

training_objective: exact logforward joint trajectory NLL plus block-map log-Jacobian; divide by H*C; mean batch
selection: same normalized trajectory NLL on normal SELECT H,2H,... once each epoch; lowest and earlier ties
scoring: final-block predictive mixture Rosenblatt, fixed flattened time/channel order, mean -log(2min(v,1-v)); v clamp1e-7; no Jacobian added to score
no_evolution: iid mode prior and A=0; transition/dynamics parameters frozen, fewer active parameters; map/emission active tensors start identically
CAL: original legitimate CAL; unchanged mature common axes, original512 PSM/SWAT and8000 TEP points; ownq99higher strict>
